name: Music Assistant
description: Media library manager that connects streaming services and local music to many players. Deploys the official Docker server in an LXC with host networking for discovery.

notes.text: Docker with host networking is mandatory. Enable nesting and keyctl (defaults here); MA, players, and HA must share one flat network/VLAN.
MA (schema 28+) requires its own login: create the admin at http://<ip>:8095/setup. Credentials cannot be recovered; hass_ingress does not bypass MA login.
If host-network Docker fails on an unprivileged LXC, retry with `var_unprivileged=0`. Unprivileged media bind mounts may also need correct host ownership.
'Sign in with Home Assistant' appears after you add the HA provider (Settings > Providers); it also imports HA media players into MA.
Optional local library: `var_media_path=/path/on/host` bind-mounts to /media. UI: http://<container-ip>:8095.
Update: `update` inside the LXC or `pct exec <CTID> -- update`; PHS_SILENT=1 for unattended. The HA add-on is developer-recommended; this is an unofficial Docker LXC.
